BackstoryDef.title: Irrigation farmer's child
BackstoryDef.description: They learned that in Dorne every channel of water could mean the difference between a thriving field and barren dust.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunspear smith's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: They forged tools, spearheads, and fittings beneath the Dornish sun.

BackstoryDef.title: Sandstone laborer's child
BackstoryDef.description: They carried stone, clay, and timber for buildings designed to remain cool through punishing heat.

BackstoryDef.title: Mosaic maker
BackstoryDef.description: Colorful stone and tile became scenes of suns, spears, flowers, and winding Dornish patterns under their hands.

BackstoryDef.title: Noble ward of Dorne
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in another Dornish court, they learned history, hospitality, and a less rigid attitude toward rank than much of Westeros.

BackstoryDef.title: Heir beneath the sun
BackstoryDef.description: Whether son or daughter, the firstborn was prepared to inherit according to Dornish custom.

BackstoryDef.title: Secondborn scion
BackstoryDef.description: Without the first claim to inheritance, they spent more time riding, hunting, and seeking their own reputation.

BackstoryDef.title: Sand-born bastard
BackstoryDef.description: Called Sand like other Dornish bastards, they faced less shame than they might have beyond the Red Mountains.

BackstoryDef.title: Desert goatherd
BackstoryDef.description: They guided animals between sparse grazing grounds and learned to notice movement across great distances.

BackstoryDef.title: Young spear page
BackstoryDef.description: Their martial education favored quick footwork and the spear rather than the heavy weapons of northern knights.

BackstoryDef.title: Greenblood farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Irrigation and careful planting let them raise food where outsiders saw only heat and dry earth.

BackstoryDef.title: Dornish bladesmith
BackstoryDef.description: They forged light blades, spearheads, and practical tools suited to the climate of Dorne.

BackstoryDef.title: Sandstone mason
BackstoryDef.description: They built shaded courtyards, thick walls, cisterns, and towers capable of enduring the desert sun.

BackstoryDef.title: Red Mountain hunter
BackstoryDef.description: They hunted goats and game across rough ground while watching constantly for snakes and sudden enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: Dornish mosaicist
BackstoryDef.description: Their brightly patterned work decorates halls, baths, gardens, and wealthy Dornish estates.

BackstoryDef.title: Desert apothecary
BackstoryDef.description: They know both healing herbs and dangerous substances found nowhere in the colder kingdoms.

BackstoryDef.title: Sunspear scholar
BackstoryDef.description: They studied Rhoynish history, Dornish law, lineages, and the long memory of conflicts with the Iron Throne.

BackstoryDef.title: Dornish spear
BackstoryDef.description: Fast, lightly equipped, and accustomed to harsh terrain, they fight differently from heavily armored Westerosi knights.

BackstoryDef.title: Water steward
BackstoryDef.description: They managed wells, irrigation rights, laborers, and supplies where control of water could decide a settlement's future.

BackstoryDef.title: Dornish court envoy
BackstoryDef.description: They know how to turn charm, patience, marriage, and carefully chosen words into weapons as effective as any spear.
